summary: Qfin Holdings (NASDAQ: QFIN; HKEx: 3660), a Chinese fintech platform, filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, reporting Q2 and interim 2026 unaudited results and declaring a semi-annual dividend. The filing includes operational metrics such as loan volume declining 25.1% to RMB63,377 million and a 90-day+ delinquency rate of 2.83%. The dividend represents a capital return to shareholders. No deal terms, premium, or advisors are disclosed. The event is routine earnings with a declared dividend; the special-situation angle is the capital return via dividend, with no further structural details.
